entries.summary: Bishop Conrad of Trento and the representatives of Tegernsee Abbey exchange real property and vineyards in the Bolzano area. Heinrich de Rosenpah is specifically designated as the intermediary who puts each party into possession of the property received in the exchange. He also appears among persons associated with Weineck.
entries.latin: § IN NOMINE SANCTE ET INDIVIDUE TRINITATIS. NOTUM SIT UNIVERSITATI FIDELIUM PRESENTIUM ET FUTURORUM concambium quod factum est inter Tridentinę sedis reverendum in Christo episcopum Chuonradum et venerabilem abbatem Manigoldum, cenobii Sancti Quiryni martiris in Teg(ri)nse, utriusque ęcclesię capitulo et conventu assensum plenarie prebente, quod sic factum est. Erat fratribus Teg(ri)nsens(is) monasterii quoddam predium iuxta fossatum suburbii Bauzani, quod dicitur vinetum in Albaro, quod dum predictus episcopus pro utilitate suę sedis a iam dicto abbate eiusque cenobii fratribus cambire intenderet, missi sunt per eundem abbatem Manigoldum coniventia totius congregationis certi internuncii in huius cambii diffini tionem, Oulricus videlicet, eorundem fratrum prepositus, et Albanus de Puosencheim, ministerialis supramemorati cenobii, qui, ut eis iniunctum erat, pereger(unt) legitime idem concambium ex parte prenotati abbatis ac suę congregationis, tradentes sine fraude et remoto omni malo ingenio cum toto et legitimo cambiendia) iure suprascriptum predium in Albaro in manus domni episcopi Chuonradi, usibus suis ac successorum suorum sine omnium hominum contradictione omnimodis profuturum. Econtra iam prememoratus domnus episcopus, predictę traditionis lege ac tenore quo ipse a prefatis legatis suprascriptam possessionem in loco Alberi acceperat, perpetuę permutationis nomine investivit predictos legatos Oulricum prepositum de Teg(ri)nse et Albanum de Puosencheim de illis vineis que pertinebant ad illam curiam quam colebat Hartwicus, cum omni eiusdem curię et harum competenti iure vinearum, quę curia fuit feodum quondam domni Folchi de Bauzano, adiciens etiam domnus episcopus in huius cambii supplementum aliam vineam quę iacet in loco et fundo Bauzani, in loco qui dicitur Hurlah, quę et est iuxta molendinum Chuonradi, fratris Hainrici Swarzi, ea conditione, quatenus prefatus domnus Manigoldus abbas de Teg(ri)nse successoresque eius cum sua tota congregatione supradictam curiam et vineas cum fundo in quo sitę sunt et cum superioribus et inferioribus eorum introitibus et exitibus ac omni utilitatis proficuo habere et tenere debeant in perpetuum, faciendum exinde libere et iuris proprietarii nomine sine omnium hominum contradictione quicquid eis utile fuerit. His ita peractis factum est iudiciario ordine et utriusque partis consensu ut utrique, et domnus episcopus et legati domni abbatis, per domnum Hainricum de Rosenpah mitterentur in tenutam permutatę possessionis. Acta sunt hęc anno dominicę incarnationis millesimo C° LXXXX° V°, indictione XIII, VI nonas martii, in die iovis, regnante serenissimo imperatore Hainrico sexto, coram domno Chuonrado, Tridentinę sedis venerabili episcopo, eo hoc ide(m)b) cambium agente in domo Arnoldi Frouweminnenman, quę est ibi iuxta extra suprascriptum suburbium Bauzani, feliciter. Et ne huius concambii contractus oblivione deleatur aut incuria pravorum hominum subvertatur sed magis futuris temporibus maiori firmitate cor roboretur, ego Manigoldus, Dei gratia Teg(ri)ns(ensis) cenobii abbas, sigilli impressione et subnotatis ministerialibus quibusdam ęcclesię nostrę et his personis qui huic negocio presentialiter interfuerunt confirmo. Huic rei interfuitc) Reinpertus, Tridentinę ęcclesię canonicus, domnus Chuonradus capellanus, domnus Roudolfus plebanus de Bauzano, domnus Roudigerus et germanus eius domnus Arnoldus, domnus Berhtoldus de Cagnao et frater eius Artwicus, domnus Albertus Tridentinę curię tabellio, Otto et germanus eius Fridericus de Winecke, Chadloghus et germanus eius Chuanzi et Fridericus et Reinpertus, Hainricus de Rosenpah et Gotschalcus, omnes de Winecke, dommus Chuonradus, Zuco et Hermannus gastaldio de Formiano, Reinpertus, Hainricus Swarze et frater eius Chunradus, Fridericus de Winchele, Bernhardus, Meinhardus et Albertus, omnes de loco Bauzano, Petarinus de Tridento et alii plures. De nostris ministerialibus hos in testimonium subscribimus: Oulricumd) de Wacherig(e)ne), Truhliebum, Chuonradum, Albanum de Puosencheim, Ottonem, Chuonradum, Oulricum, Albertum et filios eius Hainricum et Albertum de Portenhusen, Liutoldum et Chuonradum de Riede, Albanum de Richerspuowern, Liebardum, Sigibotonem, Werinhardum, Chuonradum, Werinherum de Ufhovern, Sigibotonem de Egelingen, Sigibotonem de Ekke. (SPD)
entries.english:
In the name of the holy and undivided Trinity. Let the exchange made between Conrad, reverend bishop in Christ of the see of Trento, and Manigold, venerable abbot of the monastery of Saint Quirinus the Martyr at Tegernsee, be known to all the faithful, present and future, with the full consent of the chapters and convents of both churches. It was made as follows.

The brethren of the monastery of Tegernsee had an estate beside the ditch of the suburb of Bolzano, called the vineyard at Albaro. When the aforesaid bishop intended to exchange it for the benefit of his see with the aforesaid abbot and the brethren of his monastery, the abbot Manigold, with the agreement of the whole congregation, sent certain representatives to conclude this exchange: namely, Ulrich, provost of those brethren, and Albanus of Puosencheim, ministerial of the aforesaid monastery. As instructed, they lawfully carried out the exchange on behalf of the aforesaid abbot and his congregation, handing over without fraud or deceit, with full and lawful exchange rights, the aforesaid estate at Albaro into the hands of Lord Bishop Conrad, to be of all use to him and his successors without contradiction from anyone.

In return, under the law and terms of the conveyance by which he had received the aforesaid property at Albaro from the representatives, the aforesaid lord bishop, in the name of a perpetual exchange, invested those representatives, Ulrich, provost of Tegernsee, and Albanus of Puosencheim, with the vineyards belonging to the estate cultivated by Hartwicus, together with all the rights pertaining to that estate and its vineyards. That estate had been the fief of the late Lord Folch of Bolzano. The lord bishop also added, as compensation in this exchange, another vineyard lying in the territory of Bolzano, at the place called Hurlah, next to the mill of Conradus, brother of Henry Swart. The condition was that the aforesaid Lord Manigold, abbot of Tegernsee, and his successors, with their entire congregation, should hold the aforesaid estate and vineyards, with the land on which they lie, their upper and lower approaches and exits, and every benefit belonging to them, in perpetuity, and should freely do with them, as their own property, whatever was useful to them, without contradiction from anyone.

These things having been carried out, by judicial procedure and with the consent of both parties, it was arranged that both the lord bishop and the abbot’s representatives should be put into possession of the exchanged property by Lord Henry of Rosenpah.

This was done in the year of the Lord’s incarnation 1195, indiction thirteen, on the sixth day before the Nones of March, Thursday, during the reign of the most serene Emperor Henry VI, before Lord Conrad, venerable bishop of the see of Trento, who was conducting this exchange in the house of Arnold Frouweminnenman, which stands just outside the aforesaid suburb of Bolzano. And so that this exchange agreement might not be erased through forgetfulness or overturned by the carelessness of wicked men, but instead be strengthened with greater force for future times, I, Manigold, by the grace of God abbot of the monastery of Tegernsee, confirm it by impressing my seal and by the subscriptions of certain ministerials of our church and of the persons who were present at this transaction.

Present for this matter were Reinpertus, canon of the church of Trento; Lord Conrad the chaplain; Lord Rodulfus, parish priest of Bolzano; Lord Rodegerius and his brother Lord Arnoldus; Lord Berhtoldus of Cagnao and his brother Artwicus; Lord Albert, notary of the Trento court; Otto and his brother Fridericus of Weineck; Chadloghus and his brother Chuanzi; Fridericus and Reinpertus; Henry of Rosenpah and Gotschalc, all of Weineck; Lord Conradus, Zuco and Hermannus, gastaldus of Firmian; Reinpertus; Henry Swart and his brother Conradus; Fridericus of Winchele; Bernhardus, Meinhardus and Albertus, all of Bolzano; Petarinus of Trento and many others. The following of our ministerials subscribe as witnesses: Ulricus of Wacherigen, Truhliebus, Conradus, Albanus of Puosencheim, Otto, Conradus, Ulricus, Albertus and his sons Henry and Albert of Portenhusen, Liutoldus and Conradus of Riede, Albanus of Richerspuowern, Liebardus, Sigiboto, Werinhardus, Conradus, Werinherus of Ufhovern, Sigiboto of Egelingen and Sigiboto of Ekke.

facts.subject: Heinrich de Rosenpah
facts.content: acted as the intermediary who put each party into possession of the property received in the exchange.
